title: drypetes lasiogyna
intro: Drypetes lasiogyna, commonly known as the "African Pear," is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae, characterized by its edible fruits and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Drypetes lasiogyna include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Drypetes lasiogyna include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
